description: Product Name: Power BI Baidu ECharts Stacked Bar Chart Visualization Object Version: 1.0.0 Release date: November 25, 2024 Developer: [Infortime Shiqin] Main functions: Data driven visualization: Users can directly drive stacked bar charts through Power BI's data model to achieve dynamic data display. Highly customizable: Provides multiple customization options, including color, font, legend position, etc., to meet the display needs of different users. Interactivity: Supports interactive operations such as mouse hovering and clicking, enhancing user experience. Responsive design: Stacked bar charts can adapt to different display devices and resolutions. Multi language support: Supports multiple languages to meet the needs of global users. Usage scenario: Sales analysis: Display the cumulative sales volume of different product categories over time. Performance monitoring: Display the cumulative changes in system performance indicators over different time periods. Resource utilization: Display the cumulative use of resources by different departments or projects over time. Financial report: Display the cumulative contributions of different sources of income over time. This visualization object aims to provide Power BI users with an innovative and feature rich way of presenting data, helping them better understand and analyze the cumulative effects of data.
